children: Indonesia's Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara said on Thursday that this year's economic growth could reach between 5.5% and 5.6%, slightly higher than the range of 5.4% to 5.5% he gave before the release of better-than-expected GDP data in the third quarter.
Indonesia's economy grew 5.47% in the third quarter, beating the 5.18% forecast in a Reuters poll and up from 5.29% in the second quarter, official data showed on November 5.
